title: MINIRONIN — inventario canónico de bibliotecas y política de admisión
purpose: Definir fuentes de entrenamiento, filtros de derechos, inclusión sintética y auditoría de composición temática. Este manifiesto es configuración; nunca se ingiere como texto.

source_rights.reason: Zenodo record 7313149 licenses the dataset packaging CC BY 4.0; TDX states that individual thesis rights and conditions are specified in each thesis metadata record. The current flattened text shards do not prove rights per thesis.
source_rights.action: Exclude all TDX text shards from training until rights are mapped and filtered per thesis. Keep source manifest for provenance only.

source_rights.rights: Public domain as asserted by dataset curator; preserve author/title/date/source metadata and source revision
Official BOE reuse conditions with attribution; excludes CC BY-NC-ND Biblioteca Jurídica Digital, BORME and third-party material
CC0 dataset extraction; original content limited to public-domain publications through 1900

source_rights.source: ALIA GVA communications and cultural heritage
source_rights.rights: Keep per-source CC BY 4.0 or CC BY-SA 4.0 terms and attribution; failed/unpublished acquisitions contribute zero rows
Original/generated material; synthetic=true required, reported separately from external knowledge

admission_rules: Every external source must retain source revision, license/rights note, attribution and SHA-256 manifest where available.
Remote batches count only after assets are published and their output manifests and hashes verify.
TDX content shards are excluded until per-thesis rights are available and filtered; the package-level CC BY 4.0 is not treated as a blanket license for thesis contents.
Synthetic rows are allowed in the training mix, must retain synthetic=true, and are reported separately from external source rows/tokens.
Holdout, evaluation-only and benchmark-answer files are excluded from all training roots.
Duplicates are measured and reported; they are not silently deleted by the corpus builder.
Composition percentages are reported by record count and whitespace-token proxy; these are estimates, not model-tokenizer counts.

Evaluation and holdout material is excluded both by path and by row-level split/partition/subset metadata values such as test, eval, validation, dev or holdout; exclusions are counted in the quality report.
